title: 4Ts Score for HIT
sources: Lo GK et al. J Thromb Haemost 2006
purpose: Pretest probability of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia — a low score effectively rules HIT out and avoids unnecessary non-heparin anticoagulation.

options.label: Fall > 50% AND nadir ≥ 20, no surgery in prior 3 days
Consistent but unclear (missing counts), or fall after day 10, or fall ≤ 1 day with heparin in past 30-100 days
Clear onset days 5-10, or ≤ 1 day with heparin exposure in the past 30 days
Progressive/recurrent thrombosis, non-necrotising skin lesions, or suspected thrombosis not proven
New confirmed thrombosis, skin necrosis, or acute systemic reaction after IV heparin bolus

interpretation.label: Low probability
interpretation.detail: HIT effectively excluded (NPV ~99%) — continue heparin, no HIT workup needed.

interpretation.label: Intermediate probability
interpretation.disposition: Stop heparin, start a non-heparin anticoagulant, send a HIT immunoassay ± functional assay

interpretation.label: High probability
interpretation.disposition: Stop all heparin, non-heparin anticoagulation, confirmatory testing; hematology involvement
